items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: And then we'd all sit down and listen to Earl. So they used to say, who is that kid you got up by Glovin?

ctx.x: That's all, you won't bother you.

There had a few fights. One over the entertainers and one, Jack Nelson had one at 47th Street. And I used to take Earl with me and we had up on a stand ready to go up a ladder. And then I'd put Earl up there and I'd come on down sitting with the gang, the hustlers, the pimps and things. And then we'd all sit down and listen to Earl. So they used to say, who is that kid you got up by Glovin? And I said that's a boy from Pittsburgh called Earl Hines. He said, you can play, can't he? I said, you telling me? He was…
